path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

text.description: Text to append or rewrite; an empty rewrite clears the notes.

tool.description: Exact tool name; restricts the search to its results.

before.description: Only search entries before this entry ID.

reason.description: Why a fresh window is useful now.

question.description: A concrete question the user can answer.

context.description: Short context explaining why the decision is needed.

recommended.description: Zero-based index into options: the choice you would make yourself, and the one you proceed on if nobody answers in time.

reason.description: Why this Task is parked and what you will do next, in your own terms.

wakeInSeconds.description: Wake after this many seconds. Minimum 60.

task.description: A concrete objective for one Subagent with relevant context, scope, constraints and acceptance evidence. A substantial independent end-to-end attempt is valid. The summary returns conclusions, candidate output paths and validation evidence.

attachments.description: Explicit upload IDs this delegate may inspect with read_attachment.

agent.description: A user-defined Agent from <custom_agents>, by name. Its permission decides the role and its definition fixes tools, skills, MCP servers and extra instructions for this item. A missing or switched-off Agent is an error, never a fallback.

role.description: Which role this work item runs as. executor implements and verifies; reviewer runs an independent session over the result. Omit for executor. The role's connection is read on this host when the item starts.

dependsOn.description: callIds from this Run that must finish first. A work item with unfinished prerequisites does not start until they are terminal, and does not run at all when one of them failed or was cancelled.

developmentId.description: Run this work item in its own checkout forked from the recorded requirement checkout. Its directory, not the user's working tree, becomes the delegate's project directory; ensure_workspace must have made it ready.

ticketId.description: With developmentId: the confirmed ticket this Executor implements. Its scope, acceptance criteria, what must keep working and what is out of scope are written into the task; add only the background. A continuation keeps the original's ticket.

continueCallId.description: Rework by continuing this Run's finished Executor call: same agent identity, checkpoint history and checkout, with this task appended as the next turn. The finished call stays finished; this creates one new call instead of repeating it.

reviewId.description: role=reviewer: the frozen review this Reviewer examines; needed when several are frozen. With continueCallId: the review whose finding this rework answers, recorded on the new call.

profileId.description: One-off model connection for this work item only; not saved as a role binding. A missing id is an error, never a fallback.

model.description: One-off model on the connection the role resolves to, for this work item only.

message.description: Concrete guidance for the Subagent to apply at its next turn, or the answer to its question.

questionId.description: Answer this pending question from the Subagent. Omit for ordinary guidance.

priority.description: Optional priority; higher-priority messages are reserved for urgent guidance.

reason.description: Short reason for cancelling the work.

agentId.description: Filter to one Subagent id; omit to show all Subagents.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds; default 30 seconds.

items.description: Specific async callIds whose stored result bodies you need to reread; omit for compact status. This does not consume callbacks.

scope.description: global (~/.atria/agents, every project) or project (this project's .atria/agents). Default global.

name.description: The Agent to switch off or on.

description.description: When Main should delegate to this Agent.

model.description: Omit to use the role's model.

thinking.description: Reasoning effort. Omit to use the role's.

tools.description: From read, bash, edit, write, grep, find, ls, browse_workspace, search, visit; read Agents cannot have edit or write.

prompt.description: Extra instructions after the role's prompt.

projectWrite.description: Agents may edit the user's project, not only their own directory.

longRunning.description: Jobs take minutes or hours; supervise them rather than deadline them.

reason.description: What the user authorized this for, in their terms.

request.description: lookup: the user's request in their own words.

q.description: query: match requirement title, summary or aliases.

requestId.description: Optional retry identity for a board write; a repeat returns the committed result.

expectedRevision.description: The revision returned by the last read; a stale value is refused.

summary.description: How the feature behaves now and the rules it keeps; update replaces it whole.

aliases.description: Other names for the feature; update replaces the whole list.

history.description: update: one history line, dated today.

request.description: create: the user's own words naming this feature, as they said it; kept as an alias when lookup would not have found the requirement by them.

goal.description: create/update: what this development must achieve; on the full route, its spec.

completionCriteria.description: create/update: observable conditions that make the requirement done.

route.description: The suggested path: quick, direct or full. A suggestion, not a quota.

scope.description: Relative paths or directories the ticket may change; required on the direct route.

manual.description: Instead of command: why no command can check it.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria: what to observe, under which condition, each with a command or a manual reason.

preserve.description: Nearby behaviour that must keep working.

outOfScope.description: Related changes the user did not ask for.

dependsOn.description: Ticket ids that must be merged first.

tickets.description: propose_tickets: the drafts, ids like 01, 02. They replace earlier unconfirmed drafts; confirmed tickets stay. The user confirms them on a card.

ticketId.description: revise_ticket/integrate_ticket target. freeze_candidate: review this ticket's own checkout (direct and full routes); on full, without it once every ticket is in, the final review of the whole requirement.

scope.description: Relative paths or directories the ticket may change; required on the direct route.

manual.description: Instead of command: why no command can check it.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria: what to observe, under which condition, each with a command or a manual reason.

preserve.description: Nearby behaviour that must keep working.

outOfScope.description: Related changes the user did not ask for.

dependsOn.description: Ticket ids that must be merged first.

changes.description: revise_ticket: only the fields that change. The user confirms the change on a card.

reason.description: revise_ticket: why the confirmed ticket must change.

expectedRevision.description: update: the revision returned by the last read; a stale value is refused.

channel.description: review_plan: self (Main verified a small change), independent, or combined for a final version. self checks bind to the current commit/tree; record them again after the checkout moves.

basis.description: review_plan: why this channel is justified. rule_finding: required for fix and dismiss alike. change_approach: why this approach, and for deliver_partial what is left undone.

checks.description: review_plan/record_finding/complete_review: command, exit code and captured output.

approach.description: change_approach, on the latest failed review once its chain used its two rework rounds: fresh_executor (a ticket restarts with a new Executor), revised_ticket (revise_ticket, then a new round), new_plan (the whole requirement's review: new fix tickets), or deliver_partial (accept the failed review as it is; first dismiss what stays unfixed with category=deferred). Each of the first three is used once per chain.

kind.description: freeze_candidate: independent review, or combined (which requires a combined plan) for the final version.

previousReviewId.description: freeze_candidate: the review whose findings and new changes this re-review covers.

authorCallId.description: freeze_candidate: the Executor work item that produced the candidate; its identity must differ from the Reviewer's.

callId.description: attach_reviewer, once the Reviewer work item returned by call_subagent has finished: binds it to the review and imports its submitted findings. A running Reviewer is refused; a conclusion that breaks the review's rules is refused and leaves the review free for another Reviewer. The bound Reviewer owns the review; retrying the same call is safe.

title.description: record_finding (only for a custom Reviewer that answers in prose): short finding title.

detail.description: record_finding: what is wrong and why.

findingBasis.description: record_finding with blocking=true: the criterion id it violates, or regression, data_loss, security, project_rule.

rawFailure.description: record_finding: the Reviewer's verbatim failing output, kept for later reading.

findingId.description: rule_finding: the finding to rule on.

decision.description: rule_finding: fix it or dismiss it; every ruling needs basis — for fix, how it is or will be fixed; for dismiss, why it does not stand. A suggestion blocks nothing and can only be picked up to fix. A claimed fix on a failed review can still be dismissed. Findings of failed or drifted reviews stay rulable; a passed review is closed.

category.description: rule_finding with dismiss: why the finding does not stand — or deferred, when it is left for later and reported as not done.

fromCallId.description: record_rework: the original Executor call whose session and checkout continued.

continuationCallId.description: record_rework: the continuation call returned by call_subagent continueCallId.

mergeChecks.description: request_merge: commands to run on the target-plus-candidate version; omit to reuse the recorded checks. integrate_ticket: the project's checks, run with the ticket's acceptance commands.

retro.description: request_merge: the requirement's retro, once before its last merge. pitfalls: which entries in docs/pitfalls/ were added, merged or removed (committed on top of the approved version, touching only that directory); nothing: why there is nothing to keep. improvements: changes to the agents' environment (code structure, checks, tests, instructions, tools) that would stop a trap better than a pitfall; each becomes a ledger requirement to develop after this merge. Omit retro when next does not ask for one.

verdict.description: complete_review: whether the fixed candidate satisfies the completion criteria.

scope.description: Needed to write and delete. A read without it looks in project, then user.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. write replaces a memory of the same name.

body.description: The fact; for feedback and project add why it holds and how to apply it.

name.description: Exact skill name from the available skill catalog.

path.description: Relative path inside the Task workspace; default is the workspace root.

query.description: Text to search for when mode=search.

offset.description: Byte offset for mode=read; use nextOffset from a truncated result to continue.

path.description: Single image file path, relative or absolute inside the selected root. Specify exactly one non-empty path or imageRef; omit this field or set null/"" when using the other source.

imageRef.description: Historical imageRef from this Task. Specify exactly one non-empty path or imageRef; omit this field or set null/"" when using the other source.

paths.description: Use 1–4 non-empty relative image paths, or absolute paths inside the selected root. An empty list is ignored when another source is set.

goal.description: Accepted for compatibility and unused; the images are returned to the current model.

review.description: Accepted for compatibility; true still requires a single image.

path.description: Single image file path, relative or absolute inside the selected root. Specify exactly one non-empty path or imageRef; omit this field or set null/"" when using the other source.

imageRef.description: Historical imageRef from this Task. Specify exactly one non-empty path or imageRef; omit this field or set null/"" when using the other source.

imageRef.description: Historical imageRef from this Task. Specify exactly one non-empty path or imageRef; omit this field or set null/"" when using the other source.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)
Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, relative to path, e.g. '*.ts', 'src/**/*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'. A pattern without '/' matches file names at any depth

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)
